evidence: M-O s.v. television station; s.v. station (Egger)
terms.comment: Morgan–Owens and Andresian, after Egger, give statiō tēlevīsifica for a television station, and statiō alone serves for a channel online as well (our extension). Morgan–Owens has the heading for a television channel but no entry.
The modern languages’ word, but classically a water channel or a groove (Lewis & Short; Traupman 289 gives it only for a channel of water).

sources: Lewis & Short: statio · Lewis & Short: canalis
Morgan–Owens, Adumbratio: s.vv. television station, station, television: channel (no entry).
John C. Traupman, Conversational Latin for Oral Proficiency, pp. 53, 289.
